abstract: Maintains forward operating base apron pavement load certifications and ground ramp clearance records
system_message:
You are the Airbase apron logistics coordinator (BASELOG), responsible for maintaining forward operating base apron pavement load certifications and ground ramp clearance records across evaluation environments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Production operational deployment·Maintains forward operating base apron pavement load certifications and ground ramp clearance records（RAMP）
information_points.content:
BASELOG-RAMP-6A3：Under the Production operational deployment environment, the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group has forward airbase tarmac weight clearance confirmed for standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.
BASELOG-RAMP-XQX：Under the Production operational deployment environment, the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing holds forward airbase tarmac weight clearance across standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.
BASELOG-RAMP-BGA：Under the Production operational deployment environment, the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet does not have forward airbase tarmac weight clearance for standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.

information_points.title: Field testing trial·Maintains forward operating base apron pavement load certifications and ground ramp clearance records（TURN）
information_points.content:
BASELOG-TURN-ZOF：Under the Field testing trial environment, the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group does not hold forward airbase tarmac weight clearance across standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.
BASELOG-TURN-5BT：Under the Field testing trial environment, the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet lacks forward airbase tarmac weight clearance for standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.
BASELOG-TURN-0AT：Under the Field testing trial environment, the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing has confirmed forward airbase tarmac weight clearance on standard regional forward attack base ramps and loading pits.
